name: Direct Lighting with MIS in VolPathIntegrator
definition: A method to sample direct illumination in volumetric media by combining unidirectional path sampling and light path sampling using Multiple Importance Sampling (MIS).
summary: Direct Lighting with MIS in VolPathIntegrator combines unidirectional and light path sampling using Multiple Importance Sampling to reduce color noise and variance in spectral volumetric path tracing.
